sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Two new hires start on the same day as the all-hands.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Their first day will be chaos.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We move their start date to the following day.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Better for them.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: The new hires' first day is the all-hands.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: That's a rough first day.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: They'll start the day after, then.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Good.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Benefits enrolment closes soon.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Only {PERCENT} of people have enrolled so far.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Hmm, {PERCENT}, okay.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We'll extend the deadline by a week and send a reminder.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Enrolment is only at {PERCENT}.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: {PERCENT}, that's interesting.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: And it closes soon.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: We give everyone one extra week, with a reminder.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: The interview room is double-booked tomorrow.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: The candidate is flying in.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: The candidate gets the room, and the other meeting goes online.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: Okay.

sentences.speaker: S2
sentences.text: Tomorrow's interview room is booked twice.

sentences.speaker: S3
sentences.text: And the candidate is travelling in for it.

sentences.speaker: S1
sentences.text: Then the candidate keeps the room and the other meeting moves online.
